profiles.label: FAST CRUISE
profiles.source: 1975 Cessna Cardinal RG Owner's Manual, Figure 6-4, extended-range-mixture cruise at 2,800 lb; fastest tabulated setting at each altitude, with sea-level values linearly extrapolated from 2,500/5,000 ft. Climb from Figure 6-3 at 2,800 lb; fuel-flow schedule derived from cumulative climb fuel after removing the 1.5 gal start/taxi/takeoff allowance. Descent is a rough planning assumption: cruise TAS + 5 KT and 500 FPM.

profiles.label: FAST 5500 RPM
profiles.source: Pipistrel Sinus MAX 600 LSA Aircraft Operating Instructions and Training Supplement, Revision 1 (18 May 2016), long-tip 7,500-foot cruise and climb data at 1,320 lb. Aerobag planning estimates hold the published 7,500-foot cruise TAS and fuel flow constant from sea level through 12,500 feet, extrapolate the published climb-rate schedule from 5,000 feet toward zero at the published 16,400-foot absolute ceiling, and use 105 KTAS, 2.0 GPH, and 500 FPM for powered descent.
